provider_organization: Gates Cambridge Trust, University of Cambridge
eligible_nationalities: All (citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: University Composition Fee at the appropriate rate

stipend.notes: Maintenance allowance at the 2026-27 rate, pro rata for courses shorter than 12 months. PhD awards last up to four years. May be reduced if the scholar has a salary or another large award.

additional_benefits: One economy airfare at the start and end of the course
Academic development funding (up to GBP 750 to 4,000, by course length; on application)
Family allowance for children (up to GBP 12,793 a year for one child, GBP 18,244 for two or more; on application)
Hardship and parental leave funding (on application)

application_fee.notes: Apply through the University of Cambridge postgraduate application; the university's own application fee was not checked.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: No minimum GPA; academic excellence judged on the whole application

required_documents.name: University of Cambridge postgraduate application, including the Gates Cambridge section
required_documents.detail: Full application due by 11:59pm UK time on your course's funding deadline

preparation_alerts: Check your course's funding deadline in the Cambridge Course Directory: it is either 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027
Not open to MBA, MFin, PGCE, MASt, undergraduate or part-time degrees (except the PhD)

criteria.criterion: Commitment to improving the lives of others

source_urls.title: Gates Cambridge: what the scholarship covers
source_urls.used_for: Fees, maintenance, airfare, visa, IHS, discretionary funding, about 70 awards a year

verification_status.verification_notes: All facts from official Gates Cambridge pages. Deadline stored as 8 Dec 2026 (the earlier of the two international deadlines); some courses close 6 Jan 2027. US citizens resident in the US had a separate round that closed 14 Oct 2026. About 70 scholarships a year (no applicant count found, so award_stats is null). The 2027-28 maintenance rate is not yet published; the 2026-27 rate is shown. The Cambridge course application fee was not checked.
